Name: ValleyNPCs
Author: Endwyr
Description:
Adds Gunther, Gil, Professor Snail, Birdie, and Marlon as befriendable NPCs.
You can download all 5 as one mod, or I have divided up each other character into their own separate (5) mods. Each should be clearly labelled.

== Notes ==
~None of them go to the Beach Resort.
Professor Snail:
~Cannot be gifted inside his tent, instead you must find him out in the field
(He'll be inside the Ginger Island Mushroom Cave to start, but will leave once you hit 1 Heart.)
~Will Visit Pelican Town when he has 2 Hearts, more often at 4 Hearts.
Gil:
~No longer has a rocking-chair (this is due to a limitation in my personal coding skills)
Birdie:
~Will not befriend you, until you complete "The Pirate's Wife" quest.
(You will need to sleep for the night after Quest Completion, close out of the game completely, and reopen it)
~After Quest Completion, her schedule changes completely.
Spring & Summer: Ginger Island Beach, goes to Pelican Town Beach, then Museum
Fall: She likes to go to the Forest, and see the trees change colors
Winter: She Fishes at her post, and goes to her hut around 2pm
(She may not be Giftable while she is fishing)
Fridays: She visits the Saloon
Tuesdays: She visits Prof. Snail @ his Tent

== How to Trigger Events ==
~Marlon: 7+ hearts @ the Mine, 10am and 2pm
~Gunther: 8+ hearts @ the Museum, 4pm-6pm

== 1.6 ==
Fully compatible!

==Bugs==
Birdie's Individual file is broken, Snail's is not up to date. The Main Download file should work just fine tho. I will update these eventually, I want to "complete" the mods first.

== Credits ==
~﻿ Credit to ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5732946]yoshimax[/url] for nearly all of Marlon & Gunther's content. Check out the original "Befriend Marlon and Gunther" mod!
~ Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url] for most of Gil's content. Check out the original "Make Gil Real" mod!

== Why this mod? ==
Simply put, it's always bothered me that there's NPCs ingame that you can talk to, but not friend, so I wanted to fix that, and here we are!
